member.summary: Reusable strict local text reader supporting bounded previews and complete documents.
member.remarks: The classifier is intentionally conservative: unsupported code pages and binary data are not decoded with replacement characters and never written to the terminal. This is a demonstration, not a general-purpose file format/charset detector.

member.name: M:Afrowave.Toolbox.Blackboard.TextFiles.TextFilePreviewReader.ReadCompleteAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Reads and validates an entire selected text file, without an arbitrary byte cap. Uses a small reusable decoding buffer; the returned document is materialized as one string for whole-document Markdown parsing and rendering.
member.remarks: Intended for user-initiated full documents, not the bounded generic file preview. Large documents consume memory proportional to decoded text and their Markdown syntax tree. Invalid encoding or terminal controls anywhere in the file reject the entire result.

member.name: T:Afrowave.Toolbox.Blackboard.TextFiles.Utf8DiskLineIndex
member.summary: Strict UTF-8 physical-line index backed by an on-disk temporary offset table. The entire file is validated in a sequential pass before any page is exposed. Only a fixed-size read buffer and one bounded page are kept in memory.
member.remarks: Supports optional UTF-8 BOM and LF, CRLF or CR terminators. UTF-16/32 files should use the existing TextFilePreviewReader until a dedicated encoding-aware index is added. Does not parse Markdown, wrap terminal columns or highlight code. A fresh temporary index is created for this reader and deleted on disposal.

member.name: T:Afrowave.Toolbox.Blackboard.TextFiles.Utf8DocumentOffsetIndex
member.summary: Disk-backed mapping of document-wide decoded UTF-16 offsets into UTF-8 byte offsets. The initial UTF-8 BOM is excluded from UTF-16 coordinates.
member.remarks: Builds an independent, temporary 16-byte-per-line index from a validated . Its caller retains ownership of that source. Construction is bounded-memory and batches physical-line and byte-offset reads, without repeated per-line position decoding. This is not an immutable snapshot of a concurrently modified file.
